label: Hover marquee
desc: A text ticker that drifts slowly, speeds up and reverses direction on hover, pauses on focus, and is a static list with reduced motion.
use: Under a landing hero, a perks or press strip, a footer ribbon.

label: Dynamic text shadow
desc: A headline whose long shadow always falls away from the pointer; arrow keys turn it when focused and a tap steps it on touch.
use: Landing hero headline, 404 or empty-state title, section banner.

label: Squishy labels
desc: A row of pill toggles that squash and stretch like soft bodies on hover or focus, pushing neighbours aside; press to select.
use: Tag or topic filters, preference pickers in onboarding, category chips on a menu or blog page.

label: Repelling dots
desc: A canvas dot grid whose dots are pushed away from the pointer and spring back; a gentle automatic wave on touch, static with reduced motion, paused offscreen.
use: Behind a landing hero or sign-in panel (put it first inside a position:relative section).

label: Seasons tree
desc: A tree that grows from a seed with SVG branches drawing recursively, leaves and lights blooming, a Season button (spring blossom, summer green, autumn gold with falling leaves, bare winter with snow and glowing lights), sparkles on pointer or tap, and a Regrow button.
use: Empty state, 404 or thank-you page, seasonal landing hero (inside a position:relative section with a set height).
